Hmm — "A header-section line ends with CRLF only". My implementation: the header part is text[:sep] split by "\r\n", and any remaining CR or LF in a line is an error. ✓

But there's a subtle case: what if the header part ends without the last line being terminated... Consider text = "A: b\r\nX: c\r\n\r\n" — wait, that means the header part is "A: b\r\nX: c" and the last line's terminator is the CRLF at the start of the separator ✓.

What about a case where the header part has a line at the end that is NOT terminated? That can't happen since sep is the first CRLFCRLF: text[:sep] + "\r\n" is always a properly terminated line sequence... Hmm, actually is that true? text[:sep] ends right before "\r\n\r\n". So text[:sep] is followed by CRLF — so if text[:sep] is a sequence of lines each ending with CRLF, we're fine. The split by "\r\n" gives lines that are all "terminated" in the sense that the following CRLF closes them. But could text[:sep] contain something like "A: b\rX: c" (a bare CR)? Then the split gives ["A: b\rX: c"] → my probe check catches the bare CR ✓.

What about "A: b\nX: c" → probe catches "\n" ✓.

So the "missing terminator" error can only arise when there's no CRLFCRLF at all (no separator). ✓ handled by sep < 0.

### 2. What if there's no header section at all — text starts with "\r\n\r\n"?

→ lines = [""] → the request line is empty → split(" ") gives [""] → len != 3 → syntax ✓.

### 3. Body with only "\r\n" — fine ✓.

### 4. What about a request where the body is shorter than Content-Length but the text has extra bytes?

E.g. Content-Length: 10 but the body is 5 chars → mismatch → syntax ✓.

```

X: a 
\tb
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Round 3: address/URI edge cases and tricky framing."""
import json, subprocess, sys

CTX = {
    "directory": {
        "sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121",
                                  "sip:Ember@studio.test" if False else "sip:ember@studio.test"],
        "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
        "sip:other@else.test": [],
    },
    "accounts": {
        "session-k": {"primary": "sip:ember@studio.test", "allow": ["sip:desk@sales.test", "sip:other@else.test"]},
    },
    "gateways": {
        "edge": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test"], "peers": {}},
        "wide": {"local_domains": ["studio.test", "sales.test", "else.test"], "peers": {}},
        "inside": {"local_domains": [], "peers": {"edge": ["studio.test", "sales.test"]}},
    },
}
LOCAL = {"kind": "local", "subject": "session-k"}
PEER = {"kind": "peer", "name": "edge"}
ANON = "sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"

def build(frm="From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7", to="To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>",
          extra=None, body="hello", raw_lines=None, method="MESSAGE",
          uri="sip:inbox@relay.test", callid="c1", cseq="9 MESSAGE"):
    if raw_lines is not None:
        hs = raw_lines
    else:
        hs = list(extra or []) + [frm, to, "Call-ID: " + callid, "CSeq: " + cseq]
    return ("%s %s SIP/2.0\r\n" % (method, uri) + "".join(h + "\r\n" for h in hs)
            + "Content-Length: %d\r\n\r\n" % len(body) + body)

def run(jobs, ctx=None):
    batch = dict(ctx or CTX); batch["jobs"] = jobs
    proc = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/workspace/submission/gateway.py"],
                          input=json.dumps(batch).encode(), capture_output=True)
    if proc.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("exit %d %r" % (proc.returncode, proc.stderr[-3000:]))
    return json.loads(proc.stdout.decode())["results"]

def j(raw, gw="edge", ing=LOCAL, out=True):
    return {"gateway": gw, "ingress": ing, "trusted_out": out, "raw": raw}

fails = []
def check(name, raw, expect_status, expect_reason=None, gw="edge", ing=LOCAL, ctx=None):
    got = run([j(raw, gw, ing)], ctx)[0]
    ok = got.get("status") == expect_status and (expect_reason is None or got.get("reason") == expect_reason)
    if not ok:
        fails.append(name)
        print("FAIL %-34s got %s" % (name, json.dumps(got)))
    else:
        print("ok   %-34s %s" % (name, json.dumps(got)))

S, R = "accept", "reject"

# ---- bare URI addresses ----
check("bare-from-tag", build(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test;tag=q7"), S)
check("bare-from", build(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test"), S)
check("bare-from-wsp-tag", build(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test ; tag = q7"), S)
check("bare-from-unknown-uri-param", build(frm="From: sip:ember@studio.test;transport=tcp"), R, "syntax")
check("bare-to-tag", build(to="To: tel:+12025550121;tag=ab"), S)
check("ppi-bare", build(extra=["P-Preferred-Identity: tel:+12025550122"]), S)
check("ppi-bare-tag", build(extra=["P-Preferred-Identity: tel:+12025550122;tag=x"]), R, "syntax")
check("pai-bare", build(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: tel:+12025550121"], gw="inside", ing=PEER), S, gw="inside", ing=PEER)

# ---- anonymous variants ----
check("anon-bare-upper", build(frm="From: SIP:ANONYMOUS@ANONYMOUS.INVALID."), S)
check("anon-display", build(frm='From: "Anon" <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'), S)
check("anon-escape", build(frm="From: <sip:%61nonymous@anonymous.invalid>"), S)
check("anon-tag", build(frm="From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=z"), S)
check("anon-not-alias", build(frm="From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>"), S, gw="wide")

# ---- display forms ----
check("display-token-single", build(frm="From: Bob <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"), S)
check("display-token-tabs", build(frm="From: Bob\tBill <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7"), S)
check("display-quoted-escape", build(frm='From: "B\\"ob" <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7'), S)

check("display-quoted-esc-del", build(frm='From: "B\\\x7f" <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7'), R, "syntax")

                                                "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]), S)
check("continuation-htab", build(raw_lines=["From: <sip:ember@studio", "\t.studio"[:-7] + "test>;tag=q7",
                                            "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]), R, "syntax")
check("header-empty-name", build(raw_lines=[":x", "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7",
                                            "To: <sip:inbox@relay.test>", "Call-ID: c1", "CSeq: 9 MESSAGE"]), R, "syntax")
check("empty-header-value", build(extra=["X-Empty:"]), S)
check("dup-privacy", build(extra=["Privacy: none", "Privacy: none"]), R, "syntax")
check("dup-rpid", build(extra=["Remote-Party-ID: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                               "Remote-Party-ID: <sip:ember@studio.test>"]), R, "syntax")
check("dup-ppi", build(extra=["P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
                              "P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>"]), R, "syntax")
check("pai-repeat-ok", build(extra=["P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>",
